display: Koh Samui — north-coast pier arc (Nathon / Maenam / Bangrak / Bophut)
summary: Samui's north and west coasts hold its gateway piers: Nathon (west, main municipal/ferry), Maenam and Bangrak (north, the Phangan/Tao departure points), and Bophut Fisherman's Village (northeast, leisure). This arc is the launch edge for the Samui Gulf triangle and the densest pedestal-siting opportunity on the island.

micro_demand: Bangrak/Maenam are the binding launch points for the ~12nm Samui-Phangan corridor.
Bophut Fisherman's Village concentrates premium leisure/resort transfer demand.
Nathon carries mainland ferry interchange (Donsak) plus municipal traffic.

signature_journeys.note: Core Gulf-triangle corridor; sealed in model.

navier_fit: High. Short Gulf-triangle corridors within Pioneer II range; Bangrak/Maenam already multi-operator hubs for pedestal siting; Bophut adds premium leisure willingness-to-pay.

grab_overlay.super_app_fit: Grab in-app boat-transfer booking + GrabCar/GrabBike pier handoff at Bangrak and Bophut.
grab_overlay.wedge: Premium pre-booked electric transfers from Bophut/Bangrak into the Phangan/Tao triangle, stitched to land legs in Grab.
